goal: Adaptive evidence practice in backend/routers/fsrs.py and backend/routers/quests.py.
summary: Implemented Adaptive Evidence Practice applying FSRS-5 (Free Spaced Repetition Scheduler DSR model) to scored primary source evaluation tasks across backend/routers/fsrs.py, backend/routers/quests.py, and backend/domain/helpers.py. Created database models AdaptiveEvidenceCard, AdaptiveEvidenceLog, and UserFsrsParams in backend/models.py. Developed core FSRS-5 scheduling and anti-abuse engine in backend/services/fsrs.py with 21-weight reference vector, discrete rating mapping, retrievability decay curves, and complete algorithmic transparency. Provided user opt-out controls allowing learners to toggle adaptive scheduling on/off. Enforced strict isolation between gamification XP tokenomics and cognitive memory half-life stability. Enforced negative abuse protections against rapid clicking (< 2.0s dwell time) and brute-force burst guessing (< 3.0s interval), strictly withholding mastery badges and blocking stability inflation. Integrated adaptive evidence practice into quest objective calculations and reward verification, ensuring abusive submissions yield 0 quest progress.

invariants_enforced.fsrs_primary_source_scheduling: Primary source evaluation cards (backed by historical chronicles and archival sources) are scheduled via FSRS-5 DSR equations (Difficulty, Stability, Retrievability) with continuous scores mapped to Again, Hard, Good, and Easy ratings.
invariants_enforced.algorithmic_transparency: Every task evaluation returns an algorithmic transparency payload detailing prior/new stability, difficulty, predicted retrievability R(t, S), target retention, and human-readable explanation. An API endpoint (/api/v1/fsrs/transparency) exposes the 21 default parameters and mathematical formulas.
invariants_enforced.opt_out_controls: Learners can toggle adaptive FSRS scheduling off via /api/v1/fsrs/settings and /api/v1/users/me/fsrs-settings. When opted out, reviews bypass adaptive drift and use fixed linear 1.0 day scheduling.
invariants_enforced.gamification_xp_memory_stability_isolati: Gamification XP (earned XP, streak multipliers, bonus events) is strictly separated from cognitive memory stability. Memory half-life stability is mathematically invariant to XP boosters or client-claimed XP.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_rapid_click_dwell_defense: Evaluations submitted with dwell time under 2.0 seconds are flagged with RAPID_CLICK_DWELL_VIOLATION, strictly blocking stability inflation, withholding mastery badges, and denying client-claimed badges.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_brute_force_burst_defense: Submissions occurring less than 3.0 seconds apart on the same card or multiple attempts within 10 seconds are flagged with BRUTE_FORCE_BURST_ATTEMPTS, penalizing/resetting stability to lapse levels (<= 0.5) and withholding mastery.
invariants_enforced.quest_server_verification_and_abuse_filt: Quests with adaptive_evidence_practice objectives strictly count genuine, non-abusive evaluations (abuse_detected=False). Cheat attempts yield 0 quest progress and return HTTP 400 when attempting to claim rewards before server-verified completion.

changes.description: Extended SpacedRepetitionCard with FSRS columns (fsrs_state, fsrs_difficulty, fsrs_stability, fsrs_due_date, fsrs_last_review) and added UserFsrsParams, AdaptiveEvidenceCard, and AdaptiveEvidenceLog models.

Implemented pure FSRS-5 scheduling math (DSR model, 21 weights, recall and forgetting stabilities, interval calculation), anti-abuse verification (dwell time and rapid burst detection), dynamic card provisioning, and user settings management.
Created Pydantic schemas for due evidence tasks, evaluation submissions, algorithmic transparency, model transparency, and user settings.

Created FastAPI router with endpoints for due evidence tasks (/api/v1/fsrs/evidence/due), task evaluation (/api/v1/fsrs/evidence/evaluate), algorithmic transparency (/api/v1/fsrs/transparency), and user settings (/api/v1/fsrs/settings and /api/v1/users/me/fsrs-settings).
Added quest evidence practice summary endpoint (/api/v1/quests/evidence-practice/summary) and aliased /api/v1/quests/{quest_slug}/claim-reward.
Updated _objective_current_value to verify genuine adaptive evidence practice and historical source review tasks while filtering out abuse-flagged attempts.
Registered fsrs_router in the FastAPI application factory create_app().
Added safety schema columns and imported models prior to history_models to ensure clean declarative dependency initialization.

Created comprehensive test suite verifying due task provisioning, FSRS DSR scheduling, algorithmic transparency, opt-out controls, XP vs stability separation, rapid-click abuse blocking, brute-force burst protection, and quest reward claiming.
